native_command: cargo build --release --offline --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p ca-core --example audit_odometry_steps --features parallel
native_source_scope: All local ca-core Rust sources, the new example and Cargo configurations; preserved previous dependency archives are not a hermetic build certificate.
trace_selection: All eight previously capped frames, fixed before observing these traces. Keep all 500 attempted native systems and total transforms; retain full pair rows for the last 24 states.
observer: Separate ordered exhaustive 27-cell search with an insertion/range mirror; no native bound pruning. The actual native equations and step drive the original solver.
replay_validation: Every original frame: maximum pose/threshold absolute error <=2e-8 and identical iterations/termination; publish exact pose-bit agreement separately. Independent Python checks replay all selected trace systems and final search, plus captured tail pairs.

timing.order: Alternate baseline/balanced by round plus case index; keep all samples.
timing.metric: Sum of elapsed native register calls across each complete covered recording/case, on preloaded 24000-point raw/gyro scans.
timing.includes: Range filtering, registration sampling, ICP, threshold learning, map insertion and range pruning.
timing.excludes: Bag I/O, gyro deskew, preparation, state validation, hashing, serialization, builds and diagnostic observer.
timing.limitation: Fixed real recordings and this host only; baseline/balanced closed-loop states can differ. This is policy cost, not isolated weighting overhead, Python/UI latency, GPU speedup or general throughput.

decision: Diagnose recurrence and actual cost before any solver/default adoption; no deletion or changed stopping tolerances.
